skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate a YouTube video with intro, chapters, and captions from my record...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Generator AI YouTube (v1.0.0).
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files (up to 500MB), and generate YouTube-ready videos with AI—featuring intros, chapters, and captions—within 1-2 minutes.
- No manual editing required; describe your desired output and receive polished videos automatically.
- Integrated quick start: automatic token acquisition and cloud session setup.
- Supports credit balance checks, upload, video generation, timeline previews, and one-click exports.
- Handles common errors and guides users to registration or plan upgrade if necessary.
